Maya: rolled candidate `pegasus-embed-lite-int4` to staging and ran quick webdocs-shorttail sweep. Seeing recall@1 drop for very short queries (<=8 tokens).
Liam: share command + headline numbers?
Maya: `./eval_embeddings.py --model pegasus-embed-lite-int4 --dataset webdocs-shorttail --k 1,5,10 --seed 42`  recall@1 0.58 (baseline 0.72), recall@10 0.89 (baseline 0.91). avg sim down ~0.03 on short queries.
Sasha: long queries ok?
Maya: long (>=50 tokens) unchanged.
Liam: norms? distribution?
Maya: small tightening vs fp16 baseline. suspect quant rounding in fused embed op.
Ramon: try L2 norm at inference, per-tensor ablation, and embed-table fallback to fp16.
Maya: kicked off jobs: peg-ablate-pt, peg-asym-cal, peg-embed-fallback, peg-shortflip-1k. devops-bot created 8820-8823.
Devops-bot: jobs queued.
Maya (update): embed-fallback improved short recall@1 0.69, per-tensor 0.66, asym-cal 0.63. shortflip ID-flip 4.8% vs baseline 1.3%.
Liam: fallback is a good mitigant; quantify latency delta.
Ramon: if safe, route short-query traffic or Dedicated customers to fallback. Add a short-query CI harness (1k quick queries).
Maya: will draft release note + rollout PR (canary 5% -> 20%) and attach top-50 mismatch CSV.
